title: Configure funnel report to flag missing points, unnoted absences, and stalled contacts by center
notes:
[⏱ 5m]
Integrate Apricot, class evaluation, case management, and SkillCat reports to highlight participants missing points without case notes, contacts over a week old, and job check-ins separated by center.

title: Build a communication training agent for users to upload conversations and receive feedback
notes:
[⏱ 5m]
Develop an interactive agent tool where users can upload conversation recordings, receive feedback on their communication skills, and share results with partners.

title: Design daily workflow in the Synapse app around opening journal check-ins and daily lessons
notes:
[⏱ 5m]
Structure the app user experience to open directly into the daily journal and check-in prompt, followed by a featured lesson and the meditation/exercise modules.

title: Build calendar drag-and-drop scheduling feature into the to-do app to sync with Google Calendar
notes:
[⏱ 5m]
Implement a Sunsama-style daily planning workflow that lists active reminders and allows dragging tasks directly into scheduled Google Calendar time blocks.

title: Create gold standard examples for class evaluations, case management, and LSCMI assessments
notes:
[⏱ 5m]
Partner with program managers to establish benchmark evaluation records so automated scoring tools can accurately evaluate staff documentation against clear standards.

title: Build AI extraction workflow to identify outstanding participant to-dos from case notes
notes:
[⏱ 5m]
Configure AI prompts and templates to parse case notes, identify unfulfilled participant needs such as IDs and housing plans, and track them until marked complete.

title: Generate audio recordings of Thich Nhat Hanh mindfulness readings using custom meditation voices
notes:
[⏱ 5m]
Utilize existing meditation voice models to produce narrated mindfulness and reflection readings for the app.
